recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast graphic composition featuring a vibrant red background dominated by a large, white-outlined numeral that serves as a window for a grid of colorful character portraits. The layout uses bold, rounded typography in bright yellow to anchor the bottom-left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Large numeral acts as a container for the photographic grid
High-contrast relationship between primary red field and bright yellow text
Grid cells use alternating pastel and bright background colors to separate subjects
Text elements are tightly clustered to create a singular visual unit against the negative space
coreInvariants: Yellow sans-serif typography with drop shadows
Individual portrait squares with varied solid-color backgrounds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large numeral '2' occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, containing a 3x4 grid of portraits. The main title text is scaled large in the lower-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow lowercase title in the bottom-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold yellow title, move up the curve of the large numeral, and scan the individual portraits within the grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant solid red space in the top-left and bottom-left provides breathing room for the heavy graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant Red background providing high energy and visibility.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Yellow for primary text to ensure maximum legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the numeral outline and secondary text elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all elements; the grid portraits use a mix of mint, lavender, yellow, and blue to create a 'candy-colored' variety.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain pure primary red as the base

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'g' features a circular bowl and a short, curved descender
The 'l' and 'e' are tightly packed to form a blocky silhouette
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Use a smaller, all-caps version of the same font family for metadata and secondary labels.
graphicDevices: Thick white stroke around the large numeral mask
Drop shadows on text for legibility against red

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, rounded, and playful nature of the lowercase letters.
Provides the necessary weight and rounded terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vibrant red background. On the right side, place a large white-outlined numeral '2' that acts as a mask. Inside the mask, place a grid of 12 individual portrait photos, each with a different solid pastel background color (mint, yellow, pink, blue).
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the bottom-left corner using a heavy, rounded, yellow lowercase sans-serif font. Ensure letters are touching. Add smaller secondary text in the same font above and below the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the background a pure, saturated red?
Are the letters in the main title touching or overlapping?
Does the large numeral have a distinct white border?
Are the portraits inside the numeral arranged in a clean grid?

adjustableVariables: Number of portraits in the grid
Specific pastel colors in the grid backgrounds

mustAchieve: Consistent lighting across all grid portraits
avoid: Jagged edges on the numeral mask

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow text is clearly legible against the red background.
Check that the white outline of the numeral is consistent in thickness.
Verify that the portraits are correctly clipped within the numeral shape.
Confirm the typography uses rounded terminals as specified.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vibrant Red Base + Large Numeral Mask + Multi-Color Portrait Grid + Bold Rounded Yellow Typography
